readerCopy.body: Irritation can reveal a need that has been dismissed as inconvenient long enough to become difficult to ignore. When the Moon conjoins Lilith, care and refusal fuse, making exhaustion, jealousy, anger, overstimulation, loneliness, or the need for privacy more visible. A feeling is not automatically an instruction. It is still information about where a routine or relationship may have stopped accounting for what someone actually needs.
